preDeployCommand: python scripts/validate_service_env.py api && alembic upgrade head
deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'python scripts/materialize_zepto_oauth_cache.py && unset ZEPTO_MCP_AUTH_CACHE_B64 && if [ "${RESTOCK_ENV:-development}" = "production" ]; then python scripts/validate_service_env.py api; fi && alembic upgrade head && if [ -n "${RESTOCK_REVIEWER_USER_ID:-}" ]; then if [ "${RESTOCK_REVIEWER_RESET_ON_DEPLOY:-0}" = "1" ]; then python scripts/provision_reviewer.py --reset-history; else python scripts/provision_reviewer.py; fi; fi && exec uvicorn ui.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}'
